description: Extends F1a efficiency curve with seawater density/salinity effects on pump work, seasonal surface temperature variation, and detailed parasitic load breakdown (warm pump, cold pump, working fluid pump).

eta_cycle_fraction.description: Fraction of Carnot achieved by ammonia ORC cycle

Q_warm_m3_per_s_per_kw.description: Warm seawater volume flow per kW gross (typ 3-5 kg/s/kW at rho=1025)

Q_cold_m3_per_s_per_kw.description: Cold seawater volume flow per kW gross

eta_pump_cold.description: Cold seawater pump efficiency (longer pipe, lower eta)

head_warm_m.description: Warm water intake head loss (short pipe to surface)

head_cold_m.description: Cold water pipe static + friction head (1000m deep pipe, ~800m effective head)

wf_pump_fraction.description: Working fluid pump work as fraction of gross power

salinity_cold.description: Cold deep water salinity (slightly fresher in deep ocean)

T_seasonal_amplitude_c.description: Seasonal variation amplitude of warm surface water temperature (±3C around mean)

source: Vega (2002) OTEC review, Mar. Technol. Soc. J. 36(4); Nihous (2007) J. Energy Resour. Technol. 129:10; Faizal & Ahmed (2011) Int. J. Low-Carbon Tech. 6:215; NREL OTEC resource assessment.
